---
title: "Clean Social Music Data"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
smd <- read_csv("social_music_data.csv")
head(smd) |> gt::gt()
```

```{r}
smd |> 
    select(caption = social_caption) |> 
    mutate(
    # Extract tags
    tags = str_extract_all(caption, "#\\w+"),
    
    # Extract mentioned user
    mentions = str_extract(caption, "@\\w+"),
    
    # Remove URLs
    caption = str_replace_all(caption, "https?://\\S+", "[URL]")
  ) |>
    head() |> 
    gt::gt()
```
